div.head: II Cn 4a
div.ab: And gif wiccean oððe wigleras, morðwyrhtan oððe hórcwenan ahwær on lande wurðan agitene, fyse hig man georne ut of þysum earde, oððon on earde forfare hig mid ealle, butan hig geswican ⁊ þe deoppar gebetan.

And gif wiccan oððe wigleras, morðwyrhtan oððe horcwenan ahwær on lande wurþan agytene, fysie hi man georne ut of ðysan earde, oððe on earde forfære hig mid ealle, buton hi geswycan ⁊ þe deopor gebeten.
⁊ gif wiccan oððe wigleras, morðwirhtan oððe hórcwenan ahwar on lande wurðan agitene, fise hi man georne ut of þisan earde, oððe on earde forfare hi mid ealle, buton hi geswican ⁊ þe deoppor gebetan.
Et si sage uel incantatrices, uenefice (aut murdri operarii) uel meretrices alicubi compareant, expellantur a finibus nostris uel in eis pereant, nisi cessauerint et profundius emendent.

Wiccean. Gyf wiccan oððe wigeleres, morðwyrhtan oððe horcwéonan ahwar on lande wurðon agytene, fyse hi man georne ut of ðissan earde, oððe on earde forfare hi mid ealle, buton hi geswican ⁊ ðe deoppor gebétan.

And gif wiccean oððe wigleras, morðwyrhtan oððe horcwenan ahwær on lande wurðan agitene, fyse hig man georne ut of þysum earde, oððon on earde forfare hig mid ealle, butan hig geswican and þe deoppar gebetan.

(Zauberer. B) Und wenn Zauberer oder Wahrsager, heimliche Mordstifter oder Hurenweiber irgendwo im Lande betroffen werden, jage man sie eifrig aus diesem Lande oder vernichte sie (sie sollen untergehen G) gänzlich im Lande, es sei denn, sie lassen [vom Bösen] ab und büssen um so tiefer.

(Witches. B) And if witches or soothsayers, secret murderers or whores are found anywhere in the land, let them be eagerly driven out of this country, or destroyed (let them perish, G) utterly in the land, unless they desist [from evil] and atone all the more deeply.

Wizards. If wizards or sorcerers, those who secretly compass death, or prostitutes be met with anywhere in the land, they shall be zealously driven out of this land or utterly destroyed in the land, unless they cease from their wickedness and make amends to the utmost of their ability.

And if wizards or magicians, murderers or prostitutes be found anywhere in this land, they are to be zealously expelled from the realm or they shall be entirely abolished from the earth, unless they cease and most sincerely repent.

div.note: G's ‘forfaran’ should be corrected to ‘forfare’ from the other MSS and EGu 11; G's ‘oððon’ is less original than ‘oððe’. A's ‘morðwytan’ should perhaps be ‘-wyrhtan’, or understood as ‘morð[ge]witan’ (accessories to murder). Liebermann compares EGu 11; VI Atr 7.
